title: How to Be Creative (Without Taking Drugs)
summary: 12 techniques for creativity without substances: translating ideas across mediums, consuming pre-2016 content, unconventional schedules, and periodic digital isolation.
when-to-read: Read when stuck on a creative or technical problem and want deliberate habits to generate novel inputs rather than push harder on the same approach. Do not read for systematically isolating a known defect in a system (see troubleshooting) — this is about generating novelty, not diagnosing a fault.
